intent: Technical Brief: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G15 System State Baseline
detected_fault: USB-C ports stopped working (mostly) after BIOS update
suggested_solution: Revert to previous BIOS version or wait for official ASUS support to release a fix.
Perform a clean installation of the latest drivers from ASUS website.
Disable power-saving settings related to USB-C ports.
